const d = trigger.data; const resendApiKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY; const sender = process.env.SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS || 'orders@omni.dev'; const vortexApiUrl = process.env.VORTEX_API_URL; const vortexApiKey = process.env.VORTEX_API_KEY; const heraldUrl = process.env.HERALD_API_URL; const heraldKey = process.env.HERALD_API_KEY; const heraldSender = process.env.HERALD_SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS || 'orders@send.omni.dev'; const heraldEnabled = process.env.HERALD_SEND_ENABLED === 'true' && !!heraldUrl && !!heraldKey; if (!resendApiKey && !heraldEnabled) { console.error('[halo-order-email] no email provider configured'); return { sent: 0, reason: 'no-email-provider' }; } const fmt = (c) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: d.currency || 'USD' }).format((c || 0) / 100); const rows = (d.lines || []).map((l) => `${l.title}${l.variantTitle ? ' - ' + l.variantTitle : ''} × ${l.quantity}${fmt(l.total)}`).join(''); const totals = [['Subtotal', d.subtotal], d.discountTotal ? ['Discount', -d.discountTotal] : null, d.shippingTotal ? ['Shipping', d.shippingTotal] : null, d.taxTotal ? ['Tax', d.taxTotal] : null].filter(Boolean).map((t) => `${t[0]}${fmt(t[1])}`).join(''); const summary = `${rows}${totals}
Total${fmt(d.total)}
`; const buyerHtml = `

Thank you for your order

${d.storeName} received your order ${d.orderNumber}. Here is your receipt.

${summary}

Questions? Just reply to this email.

`; const sellerHtml = `

New order ${d.orderNumber}

${d.storeName} received a new order from ${d.buyerEmail}.

${summary}
`; const recipients = [{ email: d.buyerEmail, subject: `Your ${d.storeName} order ${d.orderNumber}`, html: buyerHtml }]; if (d.sellerEmail) { recipients.push({ email: d.sellerEmail, subject: `New order ${d.orderNumber} - ${d.storeName}`, html: sellerHtml }); } const sendViaHerald = async (r) => { try { const res = await fetch(`${heraldUrl}/messages`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${heraldKey}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ to: r.email, from: heraldSender, subject: r.subject, html: r.html, idempotencyKey: `${d.orderNumber}:${r.email}` }) }); if (res.ok) { return true; } const b = await res.text().catch(() => ''); console.error(`[halo-order-email] herald failed for ${r.email}: ${res.status} ${b}`); return false; } catch (e) { console.error('[halo-order-email] herald error', e); return false; } }; const sendViaResend = async (r) => { if (!resendApiKey) { return false; } const res = await fetch('https://api.resend.com/emails', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${resendApiKey}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ from: sender, to: [r.email], subject: r.subject, html: r.html }) }); if (!res.ok) { const b = await res.text().catch(() => ''); console.error(`[halo-order-email] resend failed for ${r.email}: ${res.status} ${b}`); return false; } return true; }; let sent = 0; for (const r of recipients) { if (!r.email) { continue; } try { if (vortexApiUrl && vortexApiKey) { const sup = await fetch(vortexApiUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${vortexApiKey}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: 'query($email:String!){emailSuppressions(condition:{email:$email}){totalCount}}', variables: { email: r.email } }) }); const sj = await sup.json(); if ((sj.data?.emailSuppressions?.totalCount ?? 0) > 0) { console.log(`[halo-order-email] suppressed ${r.email}`); continue; } } } catch (e) { console.error('[halo-order-email] suppression check failed', e); } let ok = false; if (heraldEnabled) { ok = await sendViaHerald(r); } if (!ok) { ok = await sendViaResend(r); } if (ok) { sent++; } } return { sent };
